messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['You sent a payment of £250.99 GBP to Killian Hardware (parts@killiansinc.com)', "When are you going to start shipping for the item I've paid?", 'Your Ebay.com purchase receipt.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, webmaster@highwayman.com', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Order ID: ID52YF357CA Receipt Date: 08/09/2015 Order Total: 43.98 GBP', 'As a new system of promoting our shop, we are giving out exclusive vouchers as bonus to our customers.', 'You have been selected as one of the lucky winners of a thousand pounds Tesco Voucher for the year 2013.', 'Your Apple ID was used to purchase Hello by Martin Robinson, ($24.99) from iTunes Store on a device that had not previously been associated with you.', 'Thank you for shopping with us.', 'This email confirms that you have sent an eBay payment for an eBay item using PayPal.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
